title: Very difficult to close the lid...
text: Very difficult to close the lid.... This sealer has a few more bells and whistles than similar less expensive sealers such as a built in cutter to deal with rolls, and an accessory hose for cannister sealing. There is just one thing I don't like. It is hard to close the lid completely. You have to press down hard on each side, one side at a time to hear the click. I have another sealer where you simply close it and it clicks, no force, no hassle. This sealer requires us to close it one side at a time, and if you try to push it down at the same time, meaning left hand on left side, and right hand on right side... IT WILL NOT CLICK. So you have to do one side at a time, and if you don't have hand strength, you'll need to put your weight into it. Kind of ridiculous. If I'm doing something wrong, please comment below and I'll gladly change the rating of my review.  3-Stars.
